blocker_disposition.accepted_finding: Radix unmounts its portalled listbox on selection, so a second selection cannot be synchronously dispatched at the in-flight observation frame; reopening requires a portal remount whose yield lets the superseded render settle.

initiation.evaluation: async, single in-page evaluation per attempt
initiation.await_policy: awaiting inside the evaluation is allowed; no driver round-trip anywhere; nothing awaited between in-flight observation and replacement dispatch
steps: establish and assert entry state, then pre-open the combobox and await portalled listbox + target option mounted and enabled (rung fails if the option never mounts)
capture baseline snapshot, genId, seqHigh AFTER readiness so no portal-mount latency is inside the measured window
activate one option as the initiating gesture, asserted enabled and a genuine state change
rAF-poll snapshot() until a new genId shows a renderStart at seq > seqHigh with no terminal settle
synchronously, in that frame, dispatch the replacement on a distinct already-mounted control
confirm a second distinct generation with its own renderStart

blocker_disposition.replacement_rule: never a second combobox selection; always a toolbar control already in the DOM at the observation point (stepped zoom or fit button)
blocker_disposition.entry_state_rule: always 100% / custom, established by selecting 100% from the fit-width default (a real commit because fitMode changes) and letting it settle; no rung ever enters at MAX_ZOOM, so stepped + is always enabled and never a boundary no-op

runs.non_no_op_basis: initiating select sets fitMode custom, so both fit buttons are unpressed at the observation point; if a variant enters with page active, use the other mounted button fit-width
stepZoom(3.0,1)=3.1; heavy load comes from fixture/viewport/DPR, never from a max-zoom entry

blocker_disposition.rejected_alternative: entering at 400% and using zoom-out 390 -> 380; not adopted because one protocol with no max-zoom entry is coherent across every rung
blocker_disposition.ladder_rung_renamed: the former '200-page fixture at maximum zoom' rung is now the run-C higher-zoom commit, so no rung entry state can disable the replacement control
pre_dispatch_assertions: target differs from current state (data-pressed !== 'true' for fit buttons)
per_rung_recorded: expected and observed first/second generations with resulting zoom/fit targets
blocker_disposition.failure_rule: missing readiness, a failed enabled/non-no-op assertion, or a missing generation transition fails the rung and escalates; never scored
blocker_disposition.run_coverage: run B executed at the rung where run A first succeeded, escalating the same way if needed; both runs must succeed — >= 2 overlapped runs is not one run repeated
preserved_verbatim: baseline and seq > seqHigh in-flight proof
synchronous replacement in the observation frame
no completed settle on the superseded generation
full ordered event stream per run
loud final failure if in-flight is never observable
